text:
alisa: Quick check — I'm about to promote the canary for runtime v2.3 that includes the KV cache hotfix. Can people eyeball the perf gates and rollback heuristics? I want to avoid a mid-day rollback if we can catch issues early.

ops-bot: deploy-ci started for runtime-v2.3-canary (job 9876). smoke tests queued.

tariq: thx alisa. can you paste the expected p95/p99 thresholds we're gating on?

alisa: p95 <= 120ms, p99 <= 300ms, error rate < 0.3% over 10m window. Also watch memory from the new allocator: per-process RSS < 9GiB on g4dn-type nodes.

jonah: I'll run a quick microbenchmark against the canary pool in eu-west-1. ETA ~8m.

devon: heads up — the automatic fallback rule is configured: if p99 > 400ms for 5m OR error rate > 1% for 3m, roll back automatically. Manual rollback if we see functional errors in logs even if metrics look ok.

ops-bot: smoke tests passed. canary instances healthy: 4/4.

jonah: microbench done, sending summary: p50 27ms, p95 108ms, p99 285ms across 1k requests, kv-cache hit 62% (cold-to-warm traffic), token throughput steady. No obvious memory spike. Posting raw sample: ```
requests: 1000
p50: 27
p95: 108
p99: 285
errors: 0
rss_max: 8.3GiB
kv_hit: 0.62
```

nina: ran a short end-to-end QA on chat flow, everything sane. Noticed a rare latency tail on sequences > 2k tokens but probably expected. Filing a microticket TYR-412.

alisa: thanks jonah/nina. two asks: (1) can eng-sre watch the next 20m for p99 drift? (2) if we see kv_hit drop below 40% after warmup, we pause rollout and profile.

release-captain: I'm +1 to proceed with staged rollout to 10% for 30m with manual gate after observability check. eng-sre, please ack.

devon: acked. I'll have alerting on p95/p99 and a trace sample push to the tracing dashboard. Also enabling a short profiler snapshot every 10m on a single canary node.

tariq: one more quick thing — if anyone needs to run the live profiler use: ```ssh jump@canary-01 && sudo /opt/profiler/bin/snapshot --duration 30s --out /tmp/snap.pprof``` share the snap to #eng-platform for me to grab.

ops-bot: metrics-stream: p99=290ms (1m avg), errors=0.05%, kv_hit=61% (rolling). alerts=none.

alisa: looks within gates so far. staging to 10% in progress. I'll check back in 20m. :thumbsup:

jonah: if we see a p99 blip I'll kick a canary bisection script I prepared. quick command: ```python tools/bisect_canary.py --metric p99 --threshold 350 --bucket 10```

release-captain: noted. if automated rollback triggers, ops-bot will post, and I'll coordinate the postmortem.

ops-bot: canary scale event: reached 10% traffic.

devon: profiler snapshot uploaded to /artifacts/9876/canary-snap-1.pprof. linking in case team wants to inspect.

tariq: thanks — grabbing the pprof now. if anything odd shows in flamegraph I'll ping.

ops-bot: metrics-stream (10m): p95=112ms, p99=298ms, errors=0.06%, kv_hit=59%. no rollback triggered.

alisa: OK. leaving this thread open for 30m observation. If no regressions, we'll proceed to 30% next hour. Otherwise rollback plan ready.

release-captain: thanks all. post any quick findings here.

jonah: quick note — I saw one trace with an LRU miss cascade causing a 1.2s tail, sample attached. Filing an action to bump prefetch window in config for the next patch.

nina: FYI QA will run a longer session after 30% stage.

ops-bot: last_message_ts updated: 1728900300"
